name: Calneh
overview: Calneh, also known as Canneh or Calno, is identified in Scripture as a city of Assyria and is mentioned among notable ancient cities in the land of Shinar, marking the beginning of a kingdom that included Babel and Erech (Genesis 10:10). It is portrayed alongside other significant cities such as Carchemish, Hamath, and Samaria, emphasizing its recognized status in the ancient Near East (Isaiah 10:9). Additionally, Calneh is referenced in the context of commerce and territorial comparisons, inviting reflection on the strength and borders of kingdoms (Ezekiel 27:23; Amos 6:2). These passages collectively highlight Calneh's historical and geographical significance within the biblical narrative.
